provenance.projectionLabel: Source-derived model sections; not a surveyed CAD floorplan or certified route map
provenance.fillRule: evenodd; floors/context are disjoint outer and hole rings, each a flat x,z array
provenance.wallEncoding: One flat [x1,z1,x2,z2,...] array of independent section segments
provenance.siteOutlineMeaning: Projection of source n2012_g2 slab at Y0; surrounding road surfaces from n30123_g0..g3. Not a property boundary.
provenance.floorDetection: Two broad occupied slab groups at Y2.05–2.20 and Y6.10–6.22. Intermediate isolated stair treads are not additional storeys; high wall caps and roofs are excluded.
provenance.detachedSectionReason: Source pieces at Z+34.72 to +39.47 m, outside the site and without a floor surface beneath them; source geometry remains unchanged.
omittedGeometry: Furniture, vegetation, cars, glass and ambiguous movable details outside the audited architecture selection
Decorative lattice/signage unless independently listed by navigation collision candidates
Nonhorizontal slab surfaces, roof surfaces, source annotations and construction curves
Horizontal surfaces outside stated bands, including slab undersides and site depressions
Map-only segments shorter than 0.01m and polygons smaller than 0.0001m²
provenance.transformContract: Full source 4×4 world affine matrices in metres, including mirrored/nonuniform transforms; source mesh data unchanged
provenance.routes: No rooms, routes, navigability, doors, stairs-to-level connectivity or compass bearing inferred
